dedupe_keys.name: flood extent dataset in tecuci city multicare project

description: Transylvania University of Brașov publishes modelled flood extents for Tecuci City, Romania, from the Multicare project. Zenodo serves four return-period GeoTIFF maps and auxiliary XML files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The maps correspond to 50-, 100-, 500- and 1,000-year HEC-RAS scenarios. They can be overlaid with roads, buildings or service assets to screen flood exposure and compare design-event assumptions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city release. The page does not state raster resolution, coordinate reference system, flood depth or the hydraulic boundary conditions. The four maps are simulated extents, not observations of four actual events, and the return-period interpretation depends on the project model. No TIFF was downloaded, and alignment, cell classification and inundated area were not independently checked.
